versions.localizedDescription:
Huckleberry is your all-in-one baby tracker and parenting partner, trusted by 5+ million families worldwide, from your first contraction to your baby's first steps. Our award-winning baby tracker app helps new parents track baby sleep, feeding, growth, and with expert guidance at every stage.

Backed by a team of pediatric experts, Huckleberry supports every family's journey, as a maternity app through the late stages of pregnancy, a newborn tracker in the early days, a baby sleep tracker, and solid foods log as your child grows. We turn guesswork into confidence, one stage at a time.
